title: Manual check in the DAW: exported kits load with the right pads, pitches and levels
description:
## Intent

The part a machine cannot check: the preset loads in the DAW and sounds right.

## Steps (owner, in the DAW)

1. `apricity export --kit b examples/chop-shop.apr -o /tmp/chop-shop-b.adg` and the same for its drum kit.
2. Drag each preset onto an empty MIDI track. Check: the pad count and order; each pad's name; the sample and region shown in each sampler; pad 1 on C1; kick on C1 and snare on D1 for the drum kit.
3. Play pads one by one next to `apricity play` of a score that plays the same pad with `at 1`: same pitch (in tune, no transposition), roughly the same level, same length.
4. Change the DAW's tempo: warped slices follow it; unwarped one-shots do not change pitch.
5. Move the preset to another folder and reload: the samples are still found.

## Verification

A comment with the DAW version, a pass/fail per step, and any mismatch filed as a bug under this epic.

## Release

No commit. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI task.
